intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Independently invent a random complex portrait concept using the supplied visible appearance reference, and test whether foreground bokeh, concurrent window reflection and transmission, and confined edge refraction are visibly realized in one photograph. The optical keywords come from requester referenced conversation data; the workshop event and objects are agent-created staging.

An editorial photograph of an unmistakably adult fictional woman inside an old railway waiting-room converted into a small lantern workshop. Use the supplied portrait solely as guidance for visible face and hair appearance: a short dark bob with wispy center-parted fringe and softly rounded cheek contours. She wears an indigo apron over a white shirt and stands beside a coat hanging from a wooden rail near the window. She matches a narrow silk ribbon to the coat button, holding the ribbon end against the button with one hand while her other hand gently draws the loose ribbon level, both forearms comfortably in front of her torso. Her head turns slightly toward the camera, with a calm, attentive expression and both eyes clearly readable. Photograph from outside through one continuous window pane: her face and hands are visibly transmitted through clear glass, while faint reflected railway-canopy beams and an overhead wire occupy the upper and side portions of that same pane. Soft reflections cross the apron and workshop area; the central facial area remains transparent and legible. Very close to the lens, sheer saffron fabric strips blur into soft foreground bokeh along the left and lower frame edges, enclosing the sharply resolved face deeper in the scene. A small faceted prism at the extreme right edge of the camera produces a narrow peripheral refracted slice containing a displaced duplicate outline of the red indicator lamp, with a subtle spectrum fringe; the central face retains a single coherent outline. Rainy-morning window light softly models her cheeks, and a small red indicator lamp glows behind her. An open tin of numbered tags, a partly repaired lantern, and damp window droplets make the workshop tangible. Keep the eye-level portrait close enough for her expression to lead the rich layered scene.
